props.gloss_en: R' Chalafta ben Shaul: the seven blessings of Shabbat correspond to the seven 'voices' David said on the waters (Ps 29)
R' Yitzchak of Kartignin: the nine blessings of Rosh HaShana correspond to the nine mentions [of the Name] Hannah said in her prayer
on Rosh HaShana Sarah, Rachel and Hannah were remembered
R' Chelbo: the twenty-four blessings of a fast day correspond to the twenty-four 'songs' Solomon said when he brought the ark into the Holy of Holies
